movie.mainStoryPrompt: Silent Minecraft ocean adventure. Alex rows a boat over a coral reef when her compass slips into the water. A dolphin circles nearby and leads her underwater past coral and a small ocean ruin. The compass is caught in seagrass near a prismarine arch. Alex retrieves it and uses a bubble column to return to the surface. She climbs back into the boat while the dolphin jumps beside her. No dialogue, no narration, no combat.
movie.storySummary: Alex ล่องเรือเหนือแนวปะการังแต่ทำเข็มทิศตกทะเล Dolphin ช่วยนำทางเธอดำน้ำผ่าน coral reef และ ocean ruin จนพบเข็มทิศติดอยู่ใน seagrass เธอเก็บคืนและใช้ bubble column กลับสู่ผิวน้ำก่อนล่องเรือต่อ

scenes.title: Coral Sea
scenes.description: Alex rows a boat over a bright coral reef.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex พายเรือไม้ผ่านน้ำทะเลใสเหนือ coral reef
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Alex in an oak boat above a colorful coral reef, clear turquoise water, tropical fish visible below, bright daylight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide side tracking shot with the boat over the reef. Audio: gentle waves, oar splashes, upbeat exploration music. No speech.

scenes.title: Compass Overboard
scenes.description: Alex's compass slips from the boat into the water.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: เข็มทิศหลุดจากมือ Alex และตกลงข้างเรือ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex leaning from an oak boat as a compass item drops into clear ocean water, coral visible below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low tilt from Alex's hand down to the falling compass beneath the surface. Audio: item drop, splash, playful music stop. No speech.

scenes.title: A Dolphin Appears
scenes.description: A dolphin circles the boat and dives toward the compass direction.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: Dolphin ว่ายวนข้างเรือแล้วดำน้ำลงไปทางแนวปะการัง
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft dolphin beside Alex's boat, turning downward toward a colorful reef, clear blue water and sunlight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle orbit around the dolphin as it dives. Audio: dolphin clicks, water splash, hopeful music cue. No speech.

scenes.title: Follow the Dolphin
scenes.description: Alex dives and follows the dolphin underwater.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ดำน้ำตาม Dolphin ผ่านฝูงปลาและ coral fan
scenes.imageDescription: Underwater Minecraft scene, Alex swimming behind a dolphin through colorful coral fans and tropical fish, bright sunbeams from surface.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward underwater tracking shot behind Alex and the dolphin. Audio: muffled ocean ambience, bubbles, light adventure music. No speech.

scenes.title: Ocean Ruin
scenes.description: The dolphin leads Alex through a small ocean ruin arch.
scenes.actionDescription: Dolphin ว่ายลอดซุ้ม ocean ruin และ Alex ตามผ่านไป
scenes.imageDescription: Bright Minecraft ocean ruin with stone-brick arch, seagrass and coral, Alex and dolphin swimming through, no hostile mobs.
scenes.videoPrompt: Smooth tracking shot through the ruin arch. Audio: bubbles, soft stone ambience, discovery chime. No speech.

scenes.title: The Red Needle
scenes.description: Alex spots the compass caught in seagrass.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เห็นเข็มทิศติดอยู่ใน seagrass ใต้ซุ้ม prismarine
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft compass item caught in bright green seagrass near an underwater ruin, Alex pointing toward it while dolphin hovers nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in from Alex toward the compass in seagrass. Audio: bright chime, bubbles, music lifts. No speech.

scenes.title: Compass Retrieved
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เอื้อมมือเก็บเข็มทิศจาก seagrass
scenes.imageDescription: Underwater Minecraft Alex retrieving the compass item from seagrass beside the ruin, bright water and coral around.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close shot as Alex grabs the compass. Audio: item pickup sound, happy musical accent. No speech.

scenes.title: Bubble Column
scenes.description: Alex finds a bubble column rising toward the surface.
scenes.location: ช่องฟองอากาศ (Bubble Column)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เข้าไปใน bubble column และถูกฟองอากาศพาขึ้นด้านบน
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex inside a bright rising bubble column, dolphin nearby, coral reef below and sunlight above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Vertical upward tracking shot rising with Alex inside the bubble column. Audio: rushing bubbles, music builds upward. No speech.

scenes.title: Back in the Boat
scenes.description: Alex climbs back into her boat with the compass.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ปีนกลับขึ้นเรือและวางเข็มทิศไว้ข้างตัว
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Alex climbing into her oak boat above the coral reef, recovered compass visible in hand, bright sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side medium shot as Alex climbs into the boat and settles. Audio: splash, boat creak, calm music returns. No speech.

scenes.title: One Last Jump
scenes.description: The dolphin jumps beside the boat as Alex rows away.
scenes.location: แนวปะการัง (Coral Reef)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex พายเรือต่อและ Dolphin กระโดดพ้นน้ำข้างเรือหนึ่งครั้ง
scenes.imageDescription: Bright Minecraft ocean sunset beginning, Alex rowing an oak boat while a recognizable dolphin jumps beside her above the coral reef.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide tracking shot with one dolphin jump beside the moving boat. Audio: splash, uplifting music ending, waves. Fade out. No speech.
